commit.message: feat(dashboard): wire adhd-dashboard backend into compose for the React UI

pr.title: feat(dashboard): deploy adhd-dashboard backend for the React operator UI
pr.body: Adds the adhd-dashboard FastAPI backend (:8097) as a loopback-bound compose service so the live React ui-dashboard works; repairs half-wires and the deleted activity-capture dependency. User decision: keep the web dashboard.

steps.task: Add adhd-dashboard compose service + registry entry.
validation: compose.yml has an adhd-dashboard service (build services/adhd-dashboard/Dockerfile, 127.0.0.1:${ADHD_DASHBOARD_PORT:-8097}:8097, depends_on adhd-engine).
services/registry.yaml has an adhd-dashboard entry on port 8097 with category cognitive and enabled_in_smoke false.
docker compose config parses; focused dashboard, registry alignment, and environment contract tests pass.

steps.task: Repoint or remove the deleted activity-capture:8096 dependency in backend.py.
validation: No live configuration in services/adhd-dashboard/backend.py or shared/service_discovery.py references ACTIVITY_CAPTURE_URL, http://activity-capture:8096, or an activity-capture discovery mapping.
Historical tombstone prose may continue to name the removed service when it accurately documents the deletion.
docker compose -p dopemux -f compose.yml up -d --build adhd-dashboard brings the backend healthy on 127.0.0.1:8097.
GET /health returns status, service, and parseable ts fields; GET /api/adhd-state returns the dashboard state contract.
The React ui-dashboard focused test and production build pass, and browser verification confirms it connects to /ws/state and renders live state.
